BUILDPLAN.md T-20 (M3).

`popquiz schedule` / `sync`: push the affirmed question to the server over the §8.3 channel and write the **static fallback** file and its **host sheet** with T-26's build; pull `used`; reserve count, trend, and the low-reserve warning; a meetup from reserve with no generation

Criteria: AC-75–77, AC-89, AC-92, AC-101, AC-102, `SPEC.md` §12, G-12
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-11, T-18, T-19, T-25, T-26
BUILDPLAN notes: Human track: H-11, for the first deployed push

Orchestrator notes: Calls T-26's build and host-sheet functions; pushes over T-25's channel. H-11 (admin token) is needed only for the first deployed push, not to build or test.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.
data.title: Schedule and sync

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR note from PQ-4 (T-04a): the room treats the pushed record's option order as wall order and never arranges; the bank schema says file order is not wall order. So T-20's push (schedule and sync) must arrange the options into wall order from the slot function (slot_for_day only) before the room sees them. Carry this into the T-20 brief.

ORCHESTRATOR note for T-20 (from PQ-14's plan): a room can release with no wall verdict ever reported, so the used record's fit may be null. bank.py's Fit is a non-null Literal today; make it Optional when this ticket consumes used records (F-30 routed upstream).

NOTE for T-20 from PQ-26 (burst and smoke in CI, PR #39): the deployed burst and smoke runs schedule q3's record under harness ids smoke-q3 and burst-q3 over PUT /admin/questions/{id} so no bank question is released by a test run; GET /admin/used may therefore carry those harness ids - popquiz sync must tolerate them (or the README's 'restart before syncing' rule holds). Also from PQ-17: /admin/used serialises fit as null while bank.py's Used.fit is non-optional; the Bearer scheme is case-sensitive.

ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 04:5x EDT, from the Result Validator report on main @ 0a4b6fb: two facts for T-20's scope. (1) Nothing on the tree arranges options by date; every bank record stores its answer at E and the room and the fallback render stored order, so until the push half of this ticket (or the stop-gap ticket minted beside it) lands, a room from this bank shows the answer at E. (2) The used ledger and the organizer store are in memory only (room/src/used.rs:59-65, discord.rs:47-50); a Fly restart erases AC-92's record until sync pulls it, and justfile:249-251 tells the organizer to restart before the next run. Sync must land before any real meetup runs from the built app. Still held on F-15 via T-18.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 10:4x EDT — DISPATCHED on the client's Option A ruling on PQ-45 (the date-drawn arrangement before any real meetup). Worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/schedule-sync, branch ai-c11-cc/schedule-sync off origin/main @ 013076bdcd4e761f58340bf194d12979e7cc862b; mode inline-full; boot prompt at <worktree>/.claude/boot-prompt.md (copy in .lattice/orchestration/templates/boot-PQ-25.md). The dependency on PQ-23 (T-18) is loosened on the client's word: build the affirm GATE (AC-72, G-12) from the record's review fields, no affirm command. Rulings: the arrangement is applied at scheduling time to the record the room and the fallback both receive; stored bank order is never rewritten; audit.py's rules are PQ-48's. Scope: schedule (gate → arrange → PUT → fallback + host sheet from the same arranged record), sync (GET /admin/used → used blocks through bank.py's reader only — room/tests/used.rs:152 scans for Used( — F-30 null fit), the reserve lines (SPEC 3.3: warn when reserve < 2 meetups). Note: every committed record is unaffirmed; schedule must refuse all four today, and the DONE must say so.
